Two tasks (w2-08 accepted, w2-10 not) were in flight across it. The corrected wall time is weaker evidence than an uninterrupted run.

verdict: FAIL on acceptance (12 < 13), PASS on wall time (0.92 x S with the pause removed). The one-task gap is inside the stated run-to-run noise (about 3 tasks of 16): S and G fail different tasks (S: w2-01, w2-09, w2-16; G: w2-05, w2-07, w2-10, w2-16). The CPU review lanes worked mechanically -- 16 reviews spread over all three workers, no worker failures, no GPU lead fallback, and G was not slower than S -- but this run shows no quality gain from review: two worker ACCEPTs passed patches that fail a hidden test, and the one correct REVISE did not lead to a passing rework. Per the plan, no re-run until these numbers are read.
